price is relative high per gram considered globally yet you get good stuff at least.

This shop is the closest one to royal cliff resort, the demand from convenience seeking tourist makes the match so in that way perhaps justified for now.

I would rate 7/10 overall-good but based on purely subjective opinion and self testing of course.

Accessible: 8/10 - its opened until 00:00 at night and little shops around including 7Eleven. Has Wifi so can use conveniently so can order Bolt services reaching it.

Taste/smell: 7/10 - it sure smells like you are smoking good stuff. Taste is  alright.

Effects : 8/10 - within my first 5x inhales in a normal mixture tobacco (0.4gram sativa/indica hybrid/one full cigarette) joint I felt the potency. Joint is at this point at burnpoint 2/5 till finish.

Price : 4/10 price is double the European standards in a shop, just to give you a hint.

Lets be real, if you would compare what you get with self cropping including time/water/energy/logistics spent, (subject to your local area) as the utmost standard in terms of price, conclusions would be simple that this price is aimed for tourist exploitation yet it should meet it's audience perfectly and offers the stoner's requirements.

Add a half point to that in combination with high temperature environment+high humidity and great beach views and it's a stoner's experience worth spent.
